title: Journal Review
description: Spot-check text and photo WhatsApp logs, correct portions or macros, and push clean entries into the client chart.
timelineWarning: Timeline shows up to 200 entries from the last 30 days, newest first — older ones are not listed here. Switch to By client for complete per-client counts.
allCaughtUpBody: No logs match this view. Take a sip of coffee.

client.nothingBody: No entries match this view for {{name}}.

approveAll.title: Approve all clean entries?
approveAll.remainderPhrase_one: the other {{count}} pending needs a manual look
approveAll.remainderPhrase_other: the other {{count}} pending need a manual look
approveAll.body: This approves {{entries}} across {{clients}} without opening them individually. Only entries with no flags and AI confidence above "low" are included. To review one client at a time, cancel and use "Approve clean" on that client instead.
approveAll.bodyWithRemainder: This approves {{entries}} across {{clients}} without opening them individually. Only entries with no flags and AI confidence above "low" are included; {{remainder}}. To review one client at a time, cancel and use "Approve clean" on that client instead.
approveAll.nothingNone: There are no pending entries right now.
approveAll.nothingBody_one: All {{count}} pending entry needs a manual look — it is either flagged ({{flagged}}) or has low AI confidence ({{lowConf}}), so it is never approved in bulk. Open the Flagged tab to review them one by one.
approveAll.nothingBody_other: All {{count}} pending entries need a manual look — each one is either flagged ({{flagged}}) or has low AI confidence ({{lowConf}}), so they are never approved in bulk. Open the Flagged tab to review them one by one.

detail.photoAlt: Meal photo sent by the client
detail.burnNote: Estimated from the activity, duration and the client's weight. Not subtracted from their daily target — approving this records the session, it doesn't give back calories.
detail.coachNotePlaceholder: e.g. Great choice — let's swap the croissant for fruit next time.

newEntry.title: Log entry
newEntry.itemPlaceholder: e.g. "½ manoushe" or search a food →
newEntry.exerciseNote: Exercise entries are stored with the note below. Macro impact is not tracked in this version.
